text:
maria_partnerships: Heads-up — launching the SI tactile lab kits pilot for APAC the week of May 18. Need logistics signoff: packing list, trainer script, and onsite checklist. Can we sync quick? :wave:

alex_w: Got it. HW partner Nimbus confirmed capacity for 12 kits. Shipping ETA 5/10 from their SG warehouse. Need final SKU list from product.

josh_eng_ops: Network note — each kit needs a small firewall image + VPN creds to talk to our test VPC. Ops can pre-stage images if we get serials.

sana_si_program: Trainer plan: 2-day shadow + certification micro-assessment on day 3. Will reuse parts of the bootcamp curriculum but localize examples for APAC customers. Need sample rubric.

maria_partnerships: @alex_w any chance you can drop the SKU list here by EOD? Also confirm if Nimbus does drop-ship with kitting (foam inserts, power cords) or we need local fulfillment.

alex_w: SKU list attached (see below). Nimbus will do basic kitting, but they don't label customer-facing quickstart cards — we should add that.

```
- RNW-EDGE-KIT-V2 x12
- RNW-DC-PWR-CORD x12
- RNW-USB-C-CONSOLE x12
- RNW-TRAINER-QR-CARD x12 (TBD)
```

josh_eng_ops: For images: I'll upload the firewall + vpn bundle to S3 and share presigned links. Ops can also bake a management agent so kits phone home for metric collection (opt-in).

sana_si_program: For the certification micro-assessment: propose 10 scenario-based tasks (30-45 min total). I'll draft and post a sample task set by Tue. Need feedback from eng on what to include.

maria_partnerships: 👉 Action items:
- @alex_w: confirm labeling/quickstart card text + final SKU by EOD
- @josh_eng_ops: upload images + confirm phone-home agent by Fri
- @sana_si_program: draft micro-assessment and trainer script by Tue
- I'll coordinate customs paperwork and freight quotes, share in this thread.

ops_bot: Reminder: created calendar placeholder "SI APAC Tactile Kit Pilot — Planning" for 5/6 10:00 SGT. Invite sent to participants.

alex_w: Quick question: customs doc needs HS code for devices. @maria_partnerships do you want me to use the standard parts HS or pull hardware partner's paperwork?

maria_partnerships: Use Nimbus docs and cc me. I'll handle local broker. Also — let's include a QR on the quickstart card linking to localized docs / video. Keeps returns/support lower.

sana_si_program: Love the QR idea. I'll draft card wording and a short 90s video script. Can we sync 30m tomorrow?

josh_eng_ops: 30m works for me. I'll have the image presigned links ready.

maria_partnerships: Great. Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for final checklists. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
